question.text: In a transistor output characteristicy commonly used in common emitter configuration, the base current $I_{B}$, the collector current $I_{C}$ and the collector-emitter voltage $V_{C E}$ have values of the following orders of magnitude in the active region

options.text: $I_{B}$ and $I_C$ both are in $\mu \mathrm{A}$ and $V_{C E}$ in volt
$I_{B}$ is in $\mathrm{\mu A}$ and $\mathrm{I_C}$ is in $\mathrm{mA}$ and $\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{CE}}$ in volt
$I_{B}$ is in $\mathrm{mA}$ and $I_C$ is in $\mu \mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{V}_{C E}$ in $\mathrm{mV}$
$I_{B}$ is in $\mathrm{mA}$ and $I_C$ is in $\mathrm{m} \mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{V}_{C E}$ in $\mathrm{mV}$

solution.text: $I_{g}$ is in $\mu$ amp. $I_{c}$ is in $\mathrm{m}$ amp and $V_{CE}$ in volt.
